info.title: v2.ads.create_manual_product_ads
info.description: Use this API to create Manual Selection Product Ads

post.description: Use this API to create Manual Selection Product Ads

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: bid_price
parameters.description: bid price of the location

parameters.name: bid_price_per_click
parameters.description: the bid price of keyword

parameters.name: bidding_method
parameters.description: auto, manual

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: The budget set for the Auto Product Ads

parameters.name: discovery_ads_locations
parameters.description: the location settings for manual bidding method

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: the end date of each campaign. please kindly note that if you want to set an unlimited campaign, you can keep empty for the end date field

parameters.name: enhanced_cpc
parameters.description: Enhanced CPC functionality toggle

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Product ID

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: bid keyword for each campaign

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: daily_discover, you_may_also_like

parameters.name: match_type
parameters.description: exact, broad

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: A random string used to prevent duplicate ads. If an ads is created successfully, subsequent request using the same reference id will fail

parameters.name: roas_target
parameters.description: the ROAS target for each campaign with auto bidding. If 0, GMV Max / ROI feature is not enabled

parameters.name: selected_keywords
parameters.description: selected keywords, required for manual bidding mode

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: smart_creative_setting
parameters.description: Whether to use default or set on/off Smart Creative for this ad. Supported Values: "", "default", "on", "off". Empty string treated as default.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: the start date per campaign. please kindly note that if you want to set unlimited date, you can just pass today's date as the start date

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.test.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ads/create_manual_product_ads?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "bidding_method": "auto",
    "budget": 10.5,
    "discovery_ads_locations": [
        {
            "bid_price": 10.5,
            "location": "daily_discover"
        }
    ],
    "end_date": "-",
    "enhanced_cpc": true,
    "item_id": 111222,
    "reference_id": "asdf-1234-qwerty",
    "roas_target": 1.2,
    "selected_keywords": [
        {
            "bid_price_per_click": 11.2,
            "keyword": "apple",
            "match_type": "exact"
        }
    ],
    "smart_creative_setting": false,
    "start_date": "11-11-2023"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
